steps: Show the reader-only one-sheet; do not show cube source paths or evaluator rubric before first response.
Keep machine/source/runtime disclosure before the poem, but keep hostile failure labels out of the reader-facing surface.
Ask the reader to answer from the poem body and include no personal identifiers.
Copy the response into a separate JSON response object based on the intake template.
Append only real non-identifying responses; do not fabricate fixtures as evidence.
Use the evaluator rubric only after the first response is recorded.
Treat the result as local editorial pressure only unless separate ethics/legal review authorizes broader research use.
fail_conditions: source note does the poem body work
machine/runtime disclosure is more interesting than the poem
reader needs NOAA packet to feel pressure
poem reads as a graceful receipt object
admission_rule: No admission or evidence-ready status can be created by this protocol alone; project-owner acceptance and a separately logged decision are required.
non_claim: Protocol and intake readiness are not external reader evidence.
separation_rule: Failure labels such as graceful receipt object belong in the evaluator rubric, not before the poem in the reader packet.
